messages:
Maya P: Quick proposal  What if we introduce a joint co-fund offer with HW partners: they kick in a portion of the private-offer rebate to accelerate committed conversions from appliance pilots. Helps reduce Redwood cash outlay and gives HW a sales incentive.
Arjun (HW partnerships): Sounds promising. HWs like tangible attach motion. typical ask: tranche the co-fund by appliance SKU and make it time-limited. recommend 6-week conversion window post-pilot.
Tess: Do we want the offer to stack with our SI rebate? worried about double incentives. maybe a rule: only one partner-funded rebate + Redwood match, not both SI+HW.
Omar (Marketplace): Technical constraints: most clouds allow partner-funded private-offer credits but attribution must be exact. we need partner ID, offer SKU mapping, and a single redemption policy. also some marketplaces don't allow multi-party funded credits on the same private-offer. I'll check Azure/AWS/GCP differences.
Ruth (RevOps): For accounting: co-funded rebates should be recorded as contra-revenue, with HW contribution booked as partner marketing expense or offset. need partner contract clause for payment timing and clawback if customer churns within 90 days.
Legal Bot: Draft clause suggestion: "Partner contribution applies only to first invoice(s) covered by the private offer. Contributions refundable if subscription is canceled within 90 days. No double-crediting; client may not combine with other Redwood promotional discounts."
Maya P: UX idea: marketplace private-offer visible line items: Redwood_rebate, HW_credit, total_effective_discount. keeps transparency for customers and finance.
Arjun (HW partnerships): HW asks: can we surface co-funded offers in partner portal and allow partners to set max contribution per-customer? they want control to avoid over-commit.
Omar (Marketplace): Implementation sketch (ops/dev): create a composite-offer SKU that references multiple contributors. sample config: 
```
composite_offer_id: "cofund-2026-01"
contributors: [{party: "redwood", pct:50},{party: "hw_vendor_x", pct:50}]
conversion_window_days: 42
max_contribution_usd: 100000
stacking_rule: "exclusive"  # prevents SI + HW + RD overlapping
```
Will need partner billing agreement sync.
Tess: On product: add renewal escalator to discourage gaming  e.g., rebate applies to first 3 billing cycles of a 12-month commit, then standard pricing thereafter. mention in offer language.
Ruth (RevOps): Metrics to track: conversion_rate_by_partner, avg_time_to_commit, redemption_rate, incremental_revenue_at_12mo. target lift = +18% conversion vs baseline.
Maya P: Next steps: Omar to validate cloud policies by Thu; Arjun to collect HW pilot interest list; Ruth to model P&L with 3 co-fund scenarios; Legal Bot to produce draft addendum. We'll sync Tues 10am. :rocket:
